g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Azure serverless event-driven orders with Functions, Event Grid and Service Bus

g.title: None.None.Node.29
g.text: The client calls API Management, which validates the token and applies rate limits
API Management forwards the call to the orders Function App's private endpoint
The function saves the order to Cosmos DB and returns 202 Accepted
A Cosmos DB change feed trigger runs the projector for the new order
which publishes an OrderPlaced event to the Event Grid topic
An event subscription filters for order events
and delivers them to a Service Bus topic with its managed identity
The fulfilment function takes its subscription's copy and writes the receipt to Blob Storage
The notifications function takes its copy and sends the confirmation
through Azure Communication Services email, from the NAT gateway's public IP
A Logic App takes a third copy and posts the order to the ERP
